Každé téma David šije na míru publiku a&: David tailors every topic to the audience and always gets to the question everyone in the room asks anyway: what does this mean for our company, our customers and our people?
Balit se na dovolenou podle předpovědi p: Nobody would pack for a holiday based on next August’s weather forecast, and yet plenty of business plans get written that way. How to build several possible futures instead, which steps pay off in most of them, and what helps a company change course in time when the world heads elsewhere.
Geopolitické, energetické a&nbsp;ekonomi: Geopolitical, energy and economic shocks no longer arrive one at a time; they come in clusters. Where is your company’s own small Hormuz, and how do you find it before a crisis does?
Většina firem v&nbsp;eurozóně AI zatím z: Most euro area firms are still trying AI or using it lightly; only a small share use it substantially. Who will end up earning from it (firms, their employees or foreign owners), and where will it show up before it reaches the accounts?
AI: zisk pro všechny, nebo pro hrstku?: AI: gains for everyone, or for a few?
Česko stárne a&nbsp;s&nbsp;ním vaši záka: Czechia is ageing, and with it your customers, your employees and their savings. What this does to the labour market, to regions and to the life plans of the people a company sells to.
Důvěra se v&nbsp;účetnictví nevykazuje,: Trust does not appear on the balance sheet, yet it shows up in it: where it is missing, business tends to be slower and more expensive. Why it matters to companies too and how to track whether it is growing or fading.
